title: Fundamental Rights: Equality Doctrine
description: Doctrinal exploration of equality guarantees, protected grounds, and limitation analysis in Nepal's constitutional framework.

sections.title: Normative Foundations
sections.content: Equality clauses articulate normative commitments to dignity, non-subordination, and fair participation. They structure judicial scrutiny of differential treatment and guide proportionality analysis.

sections.title: Protected Grounds & Scope
sections.content: Protected grounds specify traits immune from unjustified disadvantage. Open-textured interpretation may extend analogous grounds where underlying rationales—historical disadvantage or structural exclusion—are present.

sections.title: Limitations & Tests
sections.content: Limitation analysis weighs legitimate aim, rational connection, necessity (least restrictive means), and proportionality stricto sensu. Comparative jurisprudence informs emergent domestic standards.

summary: Equality doctrine centers dignity and anti-subordination.
learningObjectives: Apply proportionality elements to a fact pattern
Explain normative bases of equality review
